analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($93,620) vs SMA5($105,690)/SMA20($108,748)/SMA50($104,270): Below short-term and mid-term trends, confirming a weak position.
· Significantly below SMA100($138,964)/SMA200($110,963): Indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (30.6%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (53.2→36.8): Attempted to enter oversold but failed to recover above 50, indicating continued weakness.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (760.0954→-1312.3374): Bearish expansion, continued decline after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Lower Band $96,533): Approaching the lower band, with band width widening to 22.47%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($68,045): Distant from the current price.
· Swing Resistance ($95,500): Close to the current price, forming a short-term resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low 92,965, 20-day low 92,965, 5-day high 115,665, 20-day high 120,080): Confirming a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.41x): Increased volume in recent movements, but lacking directional conviction.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Failed to exit oversold on RSI and continued lack of trend on ADX mean buy entry conditions are not met; maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
